(i) A parent-free, calibration-free, bottom-of-spectrum weight statistic that needs zero prompts and zero forward passes, with measured precision 0/139 false positives on eligible undeclared checkpoints at the panel operating point and measured recall 0.159 on 44 real Hub edits -- dominated on the same rows by an eleven-term filename regex at 0.727.
(ii) A decomposition showing that detection and completion are the same statement whenever discovery holds, as a consequence of the definition rather than an empirical result, with the discovery threshold located at a minimum depth weight in [0.07955950871822769, 0.5310959910353452].
